definitions.explanation: The closing portion of the current month — roughly the last week or so, or the final day depending on context. Combines {今月|こんげつ} (this month) with {末|まつ} (end). Standard in business and scheduling contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{今月末|こんげつまつ}だ。
examples.english: The deadline is the end of this month.

examples.japanese: {今月末|こんげつまつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the report by the end of this month.

examples.japanese: {今月末|こんげつまつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{荷造|にづく}り→荷造り：07938_nizukuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: I'm moving at the end of this month, so I'm busy packing.

notes:
Frequently appears in deadlines, contracts, and payment schedules. The suffix {末|まつ} marks the closing portion of a unit of time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {今月末|こんげつまつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: by the end of this month
- {今月末|こんげつまつ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by the end of this month (with deadline nuance)
- {今月末|こんげつまつ}⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧: end-of-month deadline
- {今月末|こんげつまつ}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧: end-of-month payment

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧: end of the month (any month)
- {来月末|らいげつまつ}: end of next month
- {先月末|せんげつまつ}: end of last month
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧: end of the year
- ⟦{月初|げっしょ}→月初：18530_gessho⟧: beginning of the month
